root.label: Bomb threat ruled out outside Brazil Supreme Court

events.label: Bomb threat ruled out outside Brazil Supreme Court

slots.name: bomb threat status
slots.sentence: On the same day of the cancelled debate, Brazilian police ruled out a bomb threat outside the Supreme Court.

slots.name: arrest status
slots.sentence: A suspect who “tried to jump the court’s fences” and “threw a backpack on top of a bus stop” had been arrested, the court said in a statement.

slots.name: backpack contents
slots.sentence: Authorities examined the backpack, which ultimately contained “only personal belongings,” military police spokesperson Raphael Broocke told AFP.
